items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Execute the verifier from a trusted revision**

Once `regime` is promoted to a required context, a contributor can modify `scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py` or its checker in the PR to exit successfully, because this command executes the scripts from the explicitly checked-out PR head. The warning about verifier changes is produced by the same untrusted script and does not fail the job, so the test cited by the task's `closed` threat-table row does not prevent this bypass; run trusted verifier code from the base/default branch while inspecting the PR head as data.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/4a921414a5683af752f247b1e6836010894d774d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind task policy to a trusted revision**

A contributor can add or modify both the dispatched task and its copy in the same PR, or omit the dispatched task and provide a `result.txt` containing the copy's self-computed hash. Because both alternatives are read from `head`, the contributor can authorize every changed path and make the task-copy check pass without any trusted task ever existing; this defeats the required check even with a trusted verifier. Require the policy or its binding to come from a trusted base-side record rather than another PR-controlled file.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/4a921414a5683af752f247b1e6836010894d774d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Do not exempt changes based on the source branch name**

When a PR has no task copy, any contributor can name the source branch `orchestration/...`; this condition then returns the records-only success path even when `stray` contains arbitrary code changes. Since `GITHUB_HEAD_REF` is contributor-controlled metadata rather than an authorization signal, the eventual required check is bypassed without touching the verifier; only permit the no-target result when all changed paths are actually under `.orchestration/`, or authenticate the special workflow separately.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/4a921414a5683af752f247b1e6836010894d774d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
